result.stdout:
Description:
  Small CLI to download any web resource as a markdown (with native .NET or markitdown-api).

Usage:
  MarkdownFetch <url> [<output>] [options]

Arguments:
  <url>          The URL of the web resource to fetch.
  <output file>  The path of the output markdown file. If not specified, markdown is written to stdout.

Options:
  -o, --output <output>    The path of the output markdown file (overrides positional argument if both are specified).
  --engine <engine>        Conversion engine to use: 'native' (default, pure .NET managed) or 'api' (markitdown-api). [default: native]
  --use-api                Use external markitdown-api instead of native .NET conversion (shortcut for --engine api).
  -a, --api-url <api-url>  The markitdown API server URL (automatically selects the API engine). [default: http://127.0.0.1:8490]
  -t, --timeout <timeout>  Timeout in seconds for downloading and processing. [default: 30]
  -?, -h, --help           Show help and usage information
  --version                Show version information
